what_we_sell: Podo Social: an approval-first AI social media agent for agencies and small businesses. One workspace for publishing and calendar, a unified inbox (comments, DMs, WhatsApp), lead scoring with CRM sync, Meta and Google Ads monitoring, and client-ready reports. Podo AI drafts posts, replies, weekly plans and ad suggestions; a human approves every public or paid action with one click. Built for agencies that manage many clients. India-first, Razorpay billing.
audience: 1) Digital marketing agency owners and account leads who manage many clients, Pages and ad accounts; they buy time saved and client-ready reporting. 2) SMB founders and owners in India who run their own social media with no time to spare. 3) In-house social media managers who want AI leverage while keeping their judgment in the loop.
tone_of_voice: Confident, plain-spoken, a little bold. Short sentences, concrete numbers, no hype and no buzzwords. Show the product doing real work instead of describing it.
words_to_use: approve, approval queue, one click, human in the loop, client-ready, repurpose, unified inbox, lead score, workspace, nothing goes live without your approval
words_to_avoid: posts for you automatically, fully autonomous, set and forget, guaranteed, viral, cheap, hack, revolutionary, game-changing, best in the world
hashtag_style: 3 to 5 niche hashtags at the end of Instagram, Facebook and Threads captions (for example #SocialMediaAgency #AgencyLife #SocialMediaManager #PodoSocial). None on LinkedIn text posts. No emoji spam, no hashtag walls.
languages: English. Hinglish is fine in Instagram Reels captions and Stories when it sounds natural.
brand_colours: Primary purple #612BD3, accent magenta #D82D7E, purple-to-magenta gradient for marks and CTAs, dark ink #1A1426, off-white background #FAF8FC, white text on brand colours.
visual_style: Real product screen recordings and dark-UI screenshots with generous white space. Purple-to-magenta gradient accents, bold display headlines, one idea per slide. No stock photos of people pointing at laptops.
example_posts: 1) We built an AI that drafts a week of posts in 90 seconds. Then we made it impossible for that AI to publish on its own. Here is why. 2) Monday, 9 AM. The whole week is already drafted. Not posted. Drafted. Watch the approve button do its job. 3) Your content calendar should not eat a whole Monday.
faq_answers: Does it post without me? Never. Every post, reply and ad change waits in the approval queue for a one-click approval. | Which platforms? Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Google Business Profile, Threads, Pinterest and WhatsApp. | Is it built for agencies? Yes: separate client workspaces, per-client brand kits, approvals and a client portal, client-ready PDF reports. | Pricing: do not quote numbers in posts; point people to the pricing page or a demo.
compliance_notes: Never claim the AI posts, replies or spends without approval. No invented results, metrics or testimonials; use only numbers we can show. Say when a screenshot is edited. Never show client names, Pages, ad accounts or data in screenshots or examples. No income or guaranteed-results claims. Add terms to any offer.
